notes.title: maboroshi caravan 1.0.0 Official Release
notes.notes:
maboroshi caravan official release Ver. 1.0.0 now available.   


Changed content to official release version
Added new titles
Added type to member description * If it has been recorded in the Archives
Increased member variety (appearance differences)
Increased number of random names of members
Added decorations for some members
Added SE when using shortcut keys
Fixed minor bugs


■Added new titles
The titles "Old Familiar," "Longstanding," and "Old Friend" are given to those who have early access play data.
If you start with the official release, you can get it if you meet the availability requirements. (It's a little hard.)

■Added type to member description
I implemented it based on the request.
Displayed when there is a record of a type in the Archives (= has released a member of that type).

■Increased number of random names of members
Implemented the name submitted in the Character Names Request . Thank you for sending it to me.



It was thanks to everyone who picked up the demo version and early access that it was successfully released.
Thank you very much. I sincerely appreciate it.
Please continue to observe the caravan.

notes.title: Demo version available to the public
notes.notes:
The demo version of maboroshi caravan is now available!
Watch over the caravan as it leisurely makes its way through the desert, and give it a hand from time to time. That's roughly what the game is about.

This demo version will allow you to play the basic cycle of the game. It is hoped that it will give you a rough idea of the atmosphere of the game.

The random names I have received to date have been implemented, thank you for your submissions.
Please feel free to submit any good names in the future.
Character Names Request

If you have any problems or requests, please use the Mail Form, thread
or on Twitter with the hashtag #maboroshicaravan or #まぼろしキャラバン.
Mail Form

Have a nice journey in the desert then!
